value.rationale: Complete exact shortest-route and transport-heuristic slack classification for the canonical eight-vertex cubic nonbipartite Wagner graph. Its diameter ten and 138 worst permutations give a graph-geometry benchmark contrasting with the published eight-vertex cube profile, whose diameter is twelve with one worst permutation. These natural equal-size, equal-degree graphs expose a real routing distinction not supplied by generic existence/approximation bounds.
